title: Catch
identity: The University of Melbourne Special Collections list identifies Mary Finsterer’s Catch (1990) for soprano saxophone, bass clarinet, and piano, matching the catalog instrumentation. The composer’s separate early-works page lists a Catch dated 1992 for Sydney Alpha Ensemble with duration 7:16; whether that denotes the same work/version is unresolved.

evidence.claim: University of Melbourne Southbank Collection catalogue lists Catch by Mary Finsterer (1990) for soprano saxophone, bass clarinet, and piano.

Composer’s early-works page separately lists Catch (1992) for Sydney Alpha Ensemble, duration 7:16, within a CD entry; its surrounding instrumentation prose discusses Cōnstāns and should not be transferred to Catch.

review_focus: Inference: confirm whether the composer’s 1992 Sydney Alpha Ensemble listing is a later version, a performance context for the 1990 trio, or a different work with the same title. The Melbourne catalogue supports the cataloged trio scoring, but no score was available to inspect.
collection_flag: Library catalog supports a 1990 soprano saxophone, bass clarinet, and piano score; source does not state its intended audience or whether it was commissioned.

score_links.description: Institutional collection list; no digitized score linked.

gaps: The exact relationship between the Melbourne 1990 trio record and the composer’s 1992 Sydney Alpha Ensemble listing remains unresolved.
No score pages or work-specific teaching/performance placement were inspected.
